IncidentDef.label: a runaway from the raiders' camp

texts.li: {A_nameDef} saw someone coming over the rough ground toward the gate, stopping every few steps to look back. It was {X_nameDef} of {FACTION}, bruised and cut, who had been kept at the {TALE} of {ENEMY}, {PLACE}, and slipped away from it in the night.\n\n{X_nameDef} asks for a bed until {X_pronoun} can walk home. The camp will have noticed by now that {X_pronoun} is gone.

{X_nameDef} of {FACTION} reached the colony's gate on foot and sat down against the post. {X_pronoun} was taken on the road by the people of the {TALE} {PLACE}, and has been running from them since before dawn, through brush that has scratched {X_objective} all over.\n\n{X_nameDef} would like to lie somewhere safe until the cuts close, and then go home. Whoever kept {X_objective} will be looking.

[atwar] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} has come to the gate with cuts on {X_possessive} arms and bruises on {X_possessive} face. {ENEMY} have been at war with {FACTION} a long time, and their {TALE} {PLACE} had been holding {X_objective} until {X_pronoun} got away.\n\n{X_nameDef} asks the colony for a bed and a few days. The {TALE} will want {X_objective} back.

li.label: Take {X_objective} in and see to the wounds
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} is helped through the gate and to a bed, and the colony's doctors will see to {X_possessive} cuts and bruises. When {X_pronoun} goes home, {FACTION} will know who took {X_objective} in.

li.label: Send {X_objective} on
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} gets up from the gate and limps off along the road toward {FACTION}.
